root_cause: Space-joined distinct answer/reason/next-step fields let a generic threshold-review rule absorb an unrelated order-reference next step. The matcher falsely treated that clause as an individual refund amount-review assertion.
fix: Preserve newline boundaries only for the amount-review guard; leave the matcher, scoped checker requirements and all other guards unchanged.
limits: Bounded language screening, not arbitrary semantic entailment. Earlier589receipt applies to earlier source; new clean-copy validation and matching live evidence required.
